subject: POC trial planning / success criteria & kickoff - StellarTech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@stellartech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial planning / success criteria & kickoff - StellarTech

Hi Maria —

Great to chat today. Per our discovery, putting together the proposed POC plan & timeline so we can align on success criteria and owners. High-level summary here:

- Goals / success criteria (what StellarTech needs to validate):
  - Demonstrate 95th percentile generation latency <= 300ms for typical queries (8-16 tokens generation)
  - Achieve >= 0.85 relevance score on your internal evaluation set (20 sample prompts)
  - Confirm integration path for prefix caching with your query pipeline

- Evaluation plan:
  - Redwood provides a hosted POC environment with model variant A (quantized) + model variant B (float) for comparison
  - We’ll run your evaluation harness (you provide dataset) and collect latency, token-cost, and accuracy metrics over a 2-week window

- Timeline & milestones (proposal):
  - Kickoff & environment provisioning: Week of Jun 15 (start 2026-06-15)
  - Week 1: baseline runs + instrumentation (metrics + logging)
  - Week 2: targeted tuning (batching, cache) + re-eval
  - Final readout & decision: 2026-06-30 (final presentation)

- Ownership:
  - StellarTech: Maria Lopez (POC lead), Carlos Mendes (CTO - technical signoff), data engineering for dataset prep
  - Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE/eng liaison), Logan Wright (Solutions Engineer - onboarding + tuning), Monica Patel (Customer Success - post-POC ops)

- Next steps I propose:
  1) You confirm the evaluation dataset and whether we can use the 20 sample prompts you mentioned today
  2) Confirm kickoff week (Jun 15 works on our side)
  3) I'll attach the POC plan & draft SOW for your legal/IT review

Attachment: 2026-06-05_Marissa_POC_Plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
Attachment: SOW_StellarTech_draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

If that looks right I'll lock in the kickoff and send calendar invites for the provisioning + weekly check-ins.

Thanks — talk soon,
Marissa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the plan — this is exactly what we needed. Quick answers:

- Dataset: we can share the 20 sample prompts and a 1,000-row eval set by EOD next Tuesday (2026-06-09). Will that work?
- Kickoff week: Jun 15 is fine. Our team is available Mon/Tue morning PT (10–11am PT). Can you provision the hosted POC environment by Monday morning?
- Success criteria: the metrics you listed look correct. We'll add one more business criterion: the model must correctly handle our internal entity redaction before returning results (we'll share the sample redaction rules).

I'll loop in Carlos for any security questions — Carlos, any concerns from your side on the SOW?

Thanks —
